Headline: "U.S. says more than 8 million barrels of oil transited Hormuz Sunday with military assistance"
Dated 13 July 2026. NOTE: figures below are for Sunday 12 July, NOT 18 July.

- The US Energy Department told CNBC that 8.5 million barrels of oil transited the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday despite hostilities with Iran.
- Fourteen ships transited Hormuz on Sunday, four of which were crude oil tankers - a decline of about 60% compared with the 37 vessels that crossed the same day the previous week.
- More than 100 ships transited Hormuz daily before the US and Israel launched military operations against Iran on 28 February 2026.

DIRECT QUOTE - CENTCOM statement:
"U.S. forces are positioned and prepared to ensure that freedom of navigation remains available despite unwarranted Iranian aggression."
